levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: One or more of the four required pieces is missing from the master portfolio.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: All four pieces are present and organized so each is easy to find and read on its own.

criteria.dimension: Honesty and specificity of the self-audit

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Audit judgments are unsupported ('looks good') with no specific reasoning.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Most audit judgments include a specific reason.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Every audit judgment includes a specific reason, including for pieces judged already strong.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: No real comparison is made between the warm-up prediction and the audit findings.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: States whether the prediction was accurate with a general reason.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: States whether the prediction was accurate and names something specific the audit revealed that wasn't expected.

lookFors: Each of the four portfolio pieces is recognizable as the learner's own earlier work, not newly invented for this lesson.
The audit names a specific, concrete gap for at least one piece, not a uniformly positive self-assessment.
The reflection genuinely engages with the warm-up prediction rather than restating the audit.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
